entities.summary: Earl Joseph Evans II was an American professional basketball forward who played one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Detroit Pistons during the 1979–80 season. He attended University of Nevada, Las Vegas where he was selected by the Pistons during the eight round of the 1978 NBA draft.
